# Tickblaze — How to import trades from Tickblaze into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/11517792-tickblaze-how-to-import-trades-from-tickblaze-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

To seamlessly import your trades from Tickblaze into TradeZella, follow the steps below.



- Open the desktop (Standard or Strategy) that hosts the trades you'd like to export.

Open the desktop (Standard or Strategy) that hosts the trades you'd like to export.

- If using the Strategy Desktop, ensure the strategy has been run first.

If using the Strategy Desktop, ensure the strategy has been run first.

- Go to the Orders tab.

Go to the Orders tab.

- Under the Orders tab, select Filled Orders. You should see a grid displaying the orders you want to export to TradeZella.

Under the Orders tab, select Filled Orders. You should see a grid displaying the orders you want to export to TradeZella.

- Make sure that the table contains the following columns: Symbol, Instrument, Action Type, Qty. Filled, Price, Update Date/Time (E), Update Date/Time (L), and Commission

Make sure that the table contains the following columns: Symbol, Instrument, Action Type, Qty. Filled, Price, Update Date/Time (E), Update Date/Time (L), and Commission

- If not, add it through Right-click -> Table Settings and select those in the Visible Columns

If not, add it through Right-click -> Table Settings and select those in the Visible Columns

- Right-click anywhere in the list of orders and select Export.

Right-click anywhere in the list of orders and select Export.

- Save the CSV file somewhere on your PC (just remember where you saved it)

Save the CSV file somewhere on your PC (just remember where you saved it)

- Upload the downloaded file into TradeZella

Upload the downloaded file into TradeZella



Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page or click the “Add Trade” button from the sidebar.

- If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

- Choose tickblaze as your broker.

Choose tickblaze as your broker.

- Click Continue.

Click Continue.

- Select File Upload and click Continue

Select File Upload and click Continue

- Upload your CSV file

Upload your CSV file

- If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.

If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.



## Common Errors

- Incorrect Headers in the Exported file: It's important to ensure that the exported CSV file has the following headers:Symbol | Instrument | Action Type | Qty. Filled | Price | Update Date/Time (E) | Update Date/Time (L) | Commission |

Incorrect Headers in the Exported file: It's important to ensure that the exported CSV file has the following headers:

- Symbol | Instrument | Action Type | Qty. Filled | Price | Update Date/Time (E) | Update Date/Time (L) | Commission |

Symbol | Instrument | Action Type | Qty. Filled | Price | Update Date/Time (E) | Update Date/Time (L) | Commission |

- Sample File: If your still file fails to upload, please make sure it matches the sample Tickblaze export below. If it does not match, you may have missed an import step or are uploading the incorrect file format.

Sample File: If your still file fails to upload, please make sure it matches the sample Tickblaze export below. If it does not match, you may have missed an import step or are uploading the incorrect file format.

Importing your trades from Tickblaze into TradeZella is designed to be user-friendly and efficient. By following these steps, you'll maintain accurate trading records and gain insights to optimize your trading strategies. Happy trading! 🚀
